# Internet Archive

> Internet Archive is a nonprofit digital library offering free access to books, media, software, web archives, and preservation services.

The Internet Archive preserves and provides access to millions of texts, audio recordings, videos, software titles, images, and archived web pages through the Wayback Machine. Its sites include public collections, borrowing and lending services, developer APIs, help documentation, and large-scale preservation initiatives.

## Core Platforms
- [Internet Archive Home](https://archive.org/): Main portal for searching, borrowing, streaming, downloading, and contributing digital collections.
- [Wayback Machine](https://web.archive.org/): Web archive for browsing historical snapshots of websites and saved URLs.
- [Open Library](https://openlibrary.org/): Book catalog and lending platform built around editable bibliographic records.
- [Archive-It](https://archive-it.org/): Subscription web archiving service for institutions building curated collections.
- [Internet Archive Blogs](https://blog.archive.org/): Official news, product updates, preservation stories, and organizational announcements.
- [Help Center](https://help.archive.org/): User documentation for accounts, uploading, downloading, borrowing, and site features.

## Collections & Media
- [Texts](https://archive.org/details/texts): Books, journals, magazines, and other digitized text collections.
- [Moving Image Archive](https://archive.org/details/movies): Films, television, animation, and other video materials.
- [Audio Archive](https://archive.org/details/audio): Music, spoken word, radio programs, podcasts, and live recordings.
- [Software](https://archive.org/details/software): Software titles, shareware, games, and historical computing materials.
- [Image Archive](https://archive.org/details/image): Photographs, artwork, maps, and other image collections.
- [TV News Archive](https://archive.org/details/tv): Searchable television news broadcasts with transcript-based discovery.
- [Live Music Archive](https://archive.org/details/etree): Community collection of concert recordings and live performances.
- [Collections Directory](https://archive.org/details): Browse all major media types and curated archive collections.

## Borrowing, Reading & Access
- [Books to Borrow](https://archive.org/details/inlibrary): Borrowable digital books available through controlled digital lending.
- [Open Library Borrowing](https://openlibrary.org/subjects/accessible_book): Accessible and borrowable books available through Open Library.
- [Sign Up](https://archive.org/account/signup): Create an account for borrowing, uploading, reviewing, and managing items.
- [Log In](https://archive.org/account/login): Access your Internet Archive account and saved activity.
- [My Library](https://archive.org/account/loans): View current loans and account borrowing activity.
- [Favorites](https://archive.org/account/favorites): Manage saved items and personal archive bookmarks.

## Uploading & Item Management
- [Upload to Internet Archive](https://archive.org/create/): Upload files, create items, and add metadata to new archive entries.
- [Uploading – A Basic Guide](https://help.archive.org/help/uploading-a-basic-guide/): Introductory guide to creating and publishing items on archive.org.
- [Uploading and Editing with the Internet Archive Python Library](https://help.archive.org/help/uploading-and-editing-with-the-internet-archive-python-library/): Use the Python library to automate uploads and metadata changes.
- [How to Edit Metadata](https://help.archive.org/help/how-to-edit-metadata/): Update titles, descriptions, subjects, and other item metadata fields.
- [How Do I Delete My Item?](https://help.archive.org/help/how-do-i-delete-my-item/): Explains item removal requests and deletion limitations.
- [How to Create a Collection](https://help.archive.org/help/how-to-create-a-collection/): Overview of collection creation and administrative requirements.

## Downloading & File Access
- [Downloading – A Basic Guide](https://help.archive.org/help/downloading-a-basic-guide/): Basic methods for downloading files and choosing available formats.
- [About the Internet Archive APIs](https://help.archive.org/help/about-the-internet-archive-apis/): Overview of programmatic access for metadata, files, and services.
- [Using wget to Mirror Items](https://help.archive.org/help/downloading-in-bulk-using-wget/): Download archive items in bulk from the command line.
- [File Formats and Derivatives](https://help.archive.org/help/file-formats/): Describes source files, generated derivatives, and common access formats.
- [Accessing Download Options](https://help.archive.org/help/downloading-a-basic-guide/): Explains where downloadable formats appear on item pages.
- [Item Download Directory Example](https://archive.org/download/): Base path used for direct file access and scripted downloads.

## APIs & Developer Resources
- [Internet Archive Developer Portal](https://archive.org/developers/): Entry point for APIs, tools, and developer-oriented documentation.
- [Metadata API](https://archive.org/developers/metadata-api/): Retrieve item metadata, file lists, reviews, and collection information.
- [Search API](https://archive.org/developers/search-api/): Query archive indexes and discover items programmatically.
- [Wayback Availability JSON API](https://archive.org/help/wayback_api.php): Check whether archived snapshots exist for a given URL.
- [Wayback CDX Server API](https://archive.org/developers/wayback-cdx-server-api/): Query capture indexes and timestamped web archive records.
- [Internet Archive Python Library](https://archive.org/developers/internetarchive/): Official Python tooling for uploads, downloads, and metadata operations.
- [Archive.org APIs Help Article](https://help.archive.org/help/about-the-internet-archive-apis/): High-level explanation of available APIs and common use cases.

## Wayback Machine
- [Wayback Machine Home](https://web.archive.org/): Search archived websites and access saved historical snapshots.
- [Save Page Now](https://web.archive.org/save): Submit a URL to create a new archived snapshot.
- [Wayback Machine Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/the-wayback-machine/): Help articles covering capture, playback, and troubleshooting.
- [Using the Wayback Machine](https://help.archive.org/help/using-the-wayback-machine/): Introductory guide to searching and viewing archived pages.
- [Save Pages in the Wayback Machine](https://help.archive.org/help/save-pages-in-the-wayback-machine/): Instructions for archiving live web pages on demand.
- [Wayback Machine APIs](https://archive.org/developers/wayback-machine/): Developer resources for querying and integrating web archive data.

## Help & Support
- [Help Center Home](https://help.archive.org/): Central documentation hub for Internet Archive services and workflows.
- [Account Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/accounts/): Articles about registration, login, settings, and account management.
- [Borrowing and Reading Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/borrowing-and-reading/): Support for loans, reading formats, and access restrictions.
- [Uploading and Managing Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/uploading-and-managing/): Documentation for uploads, metadata, collections, and item changes.
- [Downloading and Access Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/downloading-and-access/): Guides for file downloads, formats, and access methods.
- [Open Library Help](https://help.archive.org/help/category/open-library/): Support articles related to Open Library accounts and borrowing.
- [Contact Us](https://help.archive.org/help/contact-us/): Support contact options for common Internet Archive issues.

## Open Library
- [Open Library Home](https://openlibrary.org/): Search, borrow, and edit book records in the open catalog.
- [Subjects](https://openlibrary.org/subjects): Browse books by subject and topic.
- [Authors](https://openlibrary.org/authors): Explore author pages and linked bibliographic records.
- [Recent Changes](https://openlibrary.org/recentchanges): View recent edits made to Open Library records.
- [Developer Center](https://openlibrary.org/developers/api): API documentation for Open Library data and services.
- [Open Library Help](https://openlibrary.org/help): Documentation for editing, borrowing, and using the catalog.

## News & Organization
- [Internet Archive Blog](https://blog.archive.org/): Official blog covering projects, collections, advocacy, and product updates.
- [About the Internet Archive](https://archive.org/about/): Organizational overview, mission, and background information.
- [Projects](https://archive.org/projects/): Major preservation, access, and digitization initiatives.
- [Donate](https://archive.org/donate): Support the nonprofit’s preservation and access work.
- [Careers](https://archive.org/about/jobs.php): Employment opportunities across engineering, libraries, and operations.
- [Terms of Use](https://archive.org/about/terms.php): Legal terms governing use of archive.org services and content.
- [Privacy Policy](https://archive.org/about/privacy.php): Privacy practices for Internet Archive websites and services.
